scope: Future journal recommendation benchmark; historical eight-profile results remain preliminary and are not WSM v4 evidence.

labels.0: Not suitable or violates an expressed need

relevance.source: Independent human annotation only; never system scores or rankings.

metrics.definition: DCG divided by ideal DCG over the complete judged candidate universe.
DCG divided by ideal DCG over the complete judged candidate universe.
Count of returned labels >=2 divided by fixed K=5.
metrics.short_list_policy: Missing positions are non-relevant; denominator remains 5.

metrics.definition: Count of returned labels >=2 divided by fixed K=10.
metrics.short_list_policy: Missing positions are non-relevant; denominator remains 10.

metrics.definition: Returned relevant properties divided by all relevant properties in the judged common universe.
Mean precision at each relevant rank through 10, divided by min(number relevant in the universe, 10).
Reciprocal rank of the first label >=2, or zero when none is returned.
One when at least one label >=2 is returned in the first 10, otherwise zero.
Profiles returning at least one result divided by all evaluated profiles.
Profiles returning zero results divided by all evaluated profiles.
Returned property-destination pairs satisfying an expressed maximum commute divided by all returned pairs with a maximum.
Mean pairwise dissimilarity in prespecified property type, micro-area, rent band, and size-band features; report only when feature definitions are frozen.

aggregation.primary: Macro-average profile metrics so each tenant profile has equal weight.
aggregation.micro: Report only as a labeled sensitivity analysis, never as a substitute for macro results.
aggregation.zero_relevant_profiles: Exclude from NDCG, Recall, MAP, and MRR aggregation; report their count and include them in coverage/empty-result measures.
aggregation.multiple_profiles: Compute each metric per profile first, then aggregate with profile-level confidence intervals.

comparison_modes.end_to_end: Methods start from the common frozen universe but may create different candidate sets; report coverage and attrition at every stage.
comparison_modes.controlled_reranking: Methods receive the exact same candidate set to isolate ordering behavior.

integrity.routing: Frozen OSRM matrices shared by all route-aware methods.
integrity.label_leakage_prevention: Annotators and profile constructors cannot see system ranks, similarities, criterion scores, or final suitability.
integrity.historical_difference: The existing evaluator uses returned-count precision for short lists. Future journal results must use fixed-K precision and be versioned separately.
